record.question: Which Article of the Indian Constitution granting special status to Jammu & Kashmir was abrogated by the Union Government in 2019?
record.explanation: Answer C: Article 370. The 2019 constitutional action concerned Article 370. Reference: https://legislative.gov.in/constitution-of-india/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: LDC MPSC Paper-I, February 2025 examination; current affairs interpreted as of paper date.. Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
